text: The dishwasher-like appliance usually starts in peak-price hours (07:00-10:00 and 17:00-21:00 local time), a consistent pattern. Over the 28 observed days, starting it after the peak could have saved 6.1 SEK if you have an hourly spot-price contract, for the same 12.3 kWh of use. Next time, start it after the peak period ends instead of during it.
assumptions: F008-A04 treated as dishwasher-like (ASSUMPTION: channels are unlabelled)
counterfactual: runs moved to the first later non-peak hour (same kWh)
SEK = spot price only, excludes network fee, energy tax, VAT; depends on the student's tariff
frozen references (other flats, benchmarks, imputations) unchanged
title: Runs in expensive peak hours
disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration data (fictional flats). Numbers show the method; they are not evidence about real students or real savings.
